name: Mental Disorders: Followers of Slaanesh
description: Black Crusade, Table 8-7 (p. 279). Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: Unspeakable Urge
results.text: Must indulge once a week. Otherwise -5 to Skill Tests requiring concentration, worsening by a further -5 each week to a maximum of -20.

results.name: Irenic
results.text: -10 to all Interaction Tests when dealing with soldiers, mercenaries, Traitor Legionnaires and the like.

results.name: Absolute Pleasure
results.text: -5 to Skill Tests requiring concentration, unless the character takes care to dull physical sensation with gloves or heavy clothing.

results.name: Secretive
results.text: +5 to Willpower Tests to resist interrogation or torture, but a Difficult (-10) Willpower Test is needed to pass on even mundane information.

results.name: Perfectionist
results.text: When the GM calls for it, the character must pass a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test or take -5 to skills requiring concentration until he can set the perceived flaw right.
